consent.heading: Before we begin
consent.title: Consent & privacy
consent.intro: Your privacy and safety are our priority. Please take a moment to review the information below. It explains how we protect your data during the pilot.
consent.terms_text: By participating in this pilot programme, you agree to use UpSpeech in accordance with its intended purpose as a speech therapy support tool. Your usage data may be collected in anonymized form to improve the platform. You may withdraw from the pilot at any time by contacting your administrator.
consent.privacy_text: UpSpeech collects audio recordings, exercise data, and usage analytics to provide speech therapy services. Your data is stored securely, encrypted at rest and in transit. Your recordings are processed for speech analysis and clinical report generation, which involves trusted third-party AI providers (ElevenLabs for transcription and Google's Gemini for report generation) acting only on our instructions. We never sell your data, and we don't share it for any other purpose without your explicit consent. Your recordings are only used to train AI models if you separately opt in.
consent.required_hint: Please complete this step to continue

guardian.title: About {{child}}'s data
guardian.who: {{child}}, {{age}} years old. {{therapist}} at {{clinic}} set up their practice.
guardian.who_wrong: This is not the right child
guardian.who_wrong_title: Only the clinic can change this
guardian.who_wrong_body: We cannot edit who you act for from here. Write to the clinic and they will correct the record before you sign anything.
guardian.stored: We store what {{therapist}} assigns, the days you choose, and the one number you send after each session.
guardian.not_stored: We do not record {{child}}. There is no microphone in the practice and there never has been on this path.
guardian.how_long: It is kept while {{child}} is a patient at {{clinic}}, and deleted when the clinic closes the record.
guardian.your_control: You can ask {{therapist}} to delete everything about {{child}} at any time, and the clinic has to do it.
guardian.statement: I hold parental responsibility for {{child}}, or I have the guardian's authority to act for them.
guardian.error: We could not record that. Try again.

recording_controls.title: Recording controls
recording_controls.description: Use these controls to record your practice session. You can pause, resume, and add annotations as you practise.

first_run.expired_body: Invitations last 7 days. Ask {{therapist}} for a new one. Nothing is lost.
first_run.offline_body: The recording is saved on this phone. It goes to {{therapist}} as soon as you are back online.
first_run.resume_body: Everything is saved and there is nothing to repeat. Pick up here when there is a calm moment.

caregiver.invite_bubble: {{caregiver}}, this is where {{child}} practises at home, on your phone. {{child}} speaks, you send, I listen.
caregiver.invite_body: Six minutes for the two of you: two questions for you, a companion and a hello from {{child}}.
caregiver.how_body: A few minutes at a time, whenever there is a calm moment.
caregiver.consent_body: Children speak differently at home and in the clinic. Short, playful recordings let {{therapist}} hear {{child}} as they really are. Nothing is scored by the app.
caregiver.consent_share: I am responsible for {{child}} and I agree to the recordings being shared with {{therapist}}
caregiver.consent_share_hint: Required. Only {{therapist}} and {{clinic}} can listen. You send each one yourself.
caregiver.consent_research: Help improve UpSpeech with anonymised recordings
caregiver.mic_denied_body: Turn it on in Settings when it suits you. {{child}} can still pick a companion and see the plan.
caregiver.handover_title: Your part is done for now
caregiver.handover_body: {{child}} picks a companion and answers one question out loud. Stay close: the phone comes back to you to send it.
caregiver.pick_title: {{child}}, who do you want with you?
caregiver.pick_customise_later: You can change how I look later, in Settings.
caregiver.send_note_placeholder: e.g. After school is harder; mornings are easier.
caregiver.send_hint: Only {{therapist}} and {{clinic}} can listen. {{clinic}} usually replies within 2 working days.
caregiver.send_sent: Sent. {{therapist}} will listen and reply here.
caregiver.home_intake_body: Tell {{therapist}} about {{child}}: a few questions, a few minutes.
caregiver.reply_for_you_first: For you first, then one for {{child}}
